description: Count and list the businesses and points of interest inside an area — a bbox, a radius around a point, or a whole city — in the United States and the United Kingdom (Overture Maps places), optionally for one category. Returns the total, a breakdown by category, and the highest-confidence places. Answers "how many restaurants are in this bbox", "what kinds of businesses are within 500 m of this address", "how many gyms are in Manchester".

bbox.description: Bounding box [west, south, east, north] in decimal degrees, as an alternative to near.

category.description: Overture category, e.g. "coffee_shop", "dentist", "hotel", "restaurant", "pharmacy". Matches the basic category, the taxonomy primary or any level of its hierarchy.

city.description: City / town / locality name, e.g. "Austin" or "London". Needs country.

country.description: Country for city: "US" or "GB" (also accepts "UK", "United States", "United Kingdom").

include_closed.description: Include places Overture marks permanently_closed. Default false.

limit.description: Max places listed (0–200, default 25). Counts cover the whole area.

min_confidence.description: Hide places whose Overture existence confidence is below this (0–1). Default 0.7.

near.description: Centre point {lat, lon} in decimal degrees. Use with radius_m.

radius_m.description: Search radius in metres around near (50–50000).

region.description: Optional state or region to disambiguate city, e.g. "TX" or "Texas".

name: places_in_area
title: Places In Area
